lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three primary vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible immediately posterior to the gill slits. These columns form a regular 2D grid arrangement with approximately 5 spots per vertical row within the visible mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint but discernible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, creating a grid-like pattern where the high-luminance blobs serve as the intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank. The superior ridge exhibits a sharp vertical luminance gradient, characterized by high-intensity pixels on the upper edge and a shadowed trough directly below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct V-shaped notch is visible on the distal trailing edge of the left pectoral fin. An irregular high-luminance patch is present at the ventral insertion point (axilla) of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) visible in the ventral-lateral water column immediately below the left pectoral fin.
